armies_of_renown.name: Legions of Nagash
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS, OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS, FLESH-EATER COURTS or NIGHTHAUNT faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a LEGIONS OF NAGASH Army of Renown instead. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of any other faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box opposite. All units in your army gain the LEGIONS OF NAGASH keyword. In addition, when you pick a manifestation lore for your army, you can pick 1 of the following lores: ‘Manifestations of the Grave’, ‘Horrors of the Necropolis’, ‘Infernal Sorceries’ or ‘Manifested Insanity’.
Legends Rules: The rules in this article are Legends rules. This means that these rules cannot be used in competitive Matched Play events.
ROSTER OPTIONS
LEGIONS OF NAGASH Nagash, Supreme Lord of the Underworlds
Any non- UNIQUE DEATH units
You cannot include Regiments of Renown

battle_traits.name: Ethereal
battle_traits.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly LEGIONS OF NAGASH NIGHTHAUNT units, excluding Nagash.

battle_traits.name: Legions of Endless Dead
battle_traits.effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with 2 or more friendly units if any of those friendly units is Nagash or if none of those friendly units share any of the following keywords: SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS, FLESH-EATER COURTS, NIGHTHAUNT or OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS.

entries.name: Inescapable Fate
entries.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed.
entries.effect: If the friendly Nagash is on the battlefield, set up a replacement of this unit wholly within 12" of that Nagash and more than 9" from all enemy units. If this unit is not INFANTRY or CAVALRY, allocate 8 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

entries.name: Soul-shrive Amulet
entries.declare: Pick empowered agent or sacrificial pawn.
entries.effect:
If you picked empowered agent, for the rest of the turn:
• Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons.
If you picked sacrificial pawn, instead of making a casting roll for the next spell cast by the friendly Nagash this turn, you can use a value of 7 for the roll that cannot be modified and that spell cannot be unbound. Then, allocate 3 damage points to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

entries.name: Rise! Rise in My Name!
entries.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick each other visible friendly LEGIONS OF NAGASH unit wholly within 24" of the caster to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
If a target unit has a Health characteristic of 1, return 3 slain models to the target unit.
If a target unit has a Health characteristic of 2 or 3, return 1 slain model to the target unit and Heal (2) the target unit.
If a target unit has a Health characteristic of 4 or more, Heal (D6) the target unit.

entries.name: My Undying Demand
entries.declare: Pick the friendly Nagash to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each visible friendly LEGIONS OF NAGASH unit each phase while it is wholly within 24" of the friendly Nagash.

entries.name: Insanity and Nightmares Made Manifest
entries.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS unit and a different friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, while the targets are wholly within 12" of and visible to each other:
• Add 10 to the FLESH-EATER COURTS target's control score.
• Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with the NIGHTHAUNT target.

entries.name: Reap a Bloody Tithe
entries.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS unit and a different friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by the SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS target while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to the OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS target.
In addition, pick 1 of the following effects for the OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS target.
• Heal (D3) that unit.
• If that unit has a Health characteristic of 1 or 2, return D3 slain models to it.
• If that unit has a Health characteristic of 3 or more, return 1 slain model to it.

entries.name: Rivers of Blood and Shallow Graves
entries.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS unit and a different friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS target's weapons while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to the SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS target.
In addition, pick 1 of the following effects for the SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS target.
• Heal (D3) that unit.
• If that unit has a Health characteristic of 1 or 2, return D3 slain models to it.
• If that unit has a Health characteristic of 3 or more, return 1 slain model to it.

entries.name: Delusion and Discipline
entries.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit and a different friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, the OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS target has WARD (5+) while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to the FLESH-EATER COURTS target.
In addition, pick 1 of the following effects for the FLESH-EATER COURTS target.
• Heal (D3) that unit.
• If that unit has a Health characteristic of 1 or 2, return D3 slain models to it.
• If that unit has a Health characteristic of 3 or more, return 1 slain model to it.

entries.name: Bringing Order to Horror
entries.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit and a different friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
The NIGHTHAUNT target can use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase and even if it is in combat. However, if it does so (regardless of whether it is in combat) and the charge roll is 3 or less, that unit does not count as having charged.
In addition, the OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS target can use a RETREAT ability as if it were your movement phase, and for the rest of the turn, it can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

entries.name: Fell Blades and Bloody Fangs
entries.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit and a different friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS target's weapons while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to the NIGHTHAUNT target.
In addition, pick 1 of the following effects for the NIGHTHAUNT target.
• Heal (D3) that unit.
• If that unit has a Health characteristic of 1 or 2, return D3 slain models to it.
• If that unit has a Health characteristic of 3 or more, return 1 slain model to it.

entries.name: The Gaze of Nagash
entries.declare: Pick the friendly Nagash to cast this spell. Then, pick 2 points on the battlefield within 18" of and visible to him and within 12" of each other, Then, draw a line between those points, Each visible enemy unit the line passes across is a target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Pick normal gaze or empowered gaze.
If you picked normal gaze, inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.
If you picked empowered gaze, make an empowerment roll of 2D6. On a 6+, the roll succeeds, otherwise, the roll fails. You can keep making empowerment rolls until a roll fails. If an empowerment roll fails, the spell fails and its effect is not resolved. Otherwise, inflict D3+X mortal damage on each target, where X is the number of empowerment rolls that succeeded.

entries.name: Summon Mortalis Terminexus
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Mortalis Terminexus on the battlefield, pick a friendly NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Mortalis Terminexus wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

entries.name: Summon Shyish Reaper
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Shyish Reaper on the battlefield, pick a friendly NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Shyish Reaper wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Vault of Souls
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Vault of Souls on the battlefield, pick a friendly NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Vault of Souls wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

entries.name: Summon Cadaverous Barricade
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Cadaverous Barricade on the battlefield, pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Cadaverous Barricade wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

entries.name: Summon Chalice of Ushoran
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Chalice of Ushoran on the battlefield, pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Chalice of Ushoran wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

entries.name: Summon Corpsemare Stampede
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Corpsemare Stampede on the battlefield, pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Corpsemare Stampede wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Bone-tithe Shrieker
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Bone‑tithe Shrieker on the battlefield, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Bone-tithe Shrieker wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Nightmare Predator
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Nightmare Predator on the battlefield, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Nightmare Predator wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Soulstealer Carrion
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulstealer Carrion on the battlefield, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Soulstealer Carrion wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Hand of Nagash
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Hand of Nagash on the battlefield, pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Hand of Nagash wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Unholy Reliquary
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Unholy Reliquary on the battlefield, pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Unholy Reliquary endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them, and more than 3" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Sanguine Swarm
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Sanguine Swarm on the battlefield, pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Sanguine Swarm endless spell wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Sanguine Swarm endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

armies_of_renown.name: The Knights of New Summercourt
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Flesh-eater Courts faction for your army, you can choose for it to be the Knights of New Summercourt Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules in this section instead of the Flesh-eater Courts faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the NEW SUMMERCOURT keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Ushoran, Mortarch of Delusion (must be included)
Any NON-UNIQUE ABHORRANTS
Any NOBLES
Varghulf Courtiers
Any KNIGHTS units
You cannot include Regiments of Renown

battle_traits.name: The Summerking's Colours
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT unit that contains any standard bearers to be the target.
battle_traits.effect:
For the rest of the battle:
• While the target unit contains any standard bearers, add 10 to the control scores of friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT units while they are wholly within 24" of the target.
• Once all of the standard bearers in the target unit have been slain, subtract 5 from the control scores of friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT units.

battle_traits.name: A Duel, Good Sir
battle_traits.declare: You must use this ability if the friendly Ushoran is in combat with the enemy general. Pick the enemy general to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or refuse Ushoran's challenge.

options.name: Accept
options.text: For the rest of the turn, when the friendly Ushoran and the target are picked to use a FIGHT ability, all of their attacks must target each other.

options.name: Refuse
options.text: The target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

battle_traits.name: In Their Sire's Shadow
battle_traits.declare: If the friendly Ushoran is not in combat and has not used any RUN or RETREAT abilities this turn, pick him to use this ability. Then, pick up to 2 friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT KNIGHTS units within his combat range that are not in combat and have not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to be his royal retinue. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
battle_traits.effect: The friendly Ushoran can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. He can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If he does so, he has charged. If he charged, then after this ability has been resolved, each unit in his royal retinue can immediately use the 'Charge' ability even if it is not your charge phase and you can use the charge roll from this ability instead of making a charge roll when it does so, but it must end the charge move within 3" of the friendly Ushoran.

battle_traits.name: The Knight's Vow
battle_traits.declare: Pick each friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT unit that did not charge this turn to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect: Start rolling dice, one at a time and one for each target, and stop when you roll a 6. The target you rolled a 6 for can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn. If you rolled for each target and did not roll a 6, this ability has no effect.

battle_traits.name: Nightmarish Charge
battle_traits.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT units that charged in the same turn.

battle_traits.name: Red Errantry Hosts
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly KNIGHTS unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Tip of the King's Lance
entries.effect: If this unit charged this turn, it can move 2D6". It can pass through models in enemy units, but it must end that move in combat.

entries.name: Feted Coronet
entries.effect: This unit has WARD (4+) until a friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT unit is destroyed.

entries.name: Deranged Transformation
entries.declare: Pick a friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT INFANTRY or CAVALRY unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks.

entries.name: Miasma of Madness
entries.declare: Pick a friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by the target, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.name: Excommunication
entries.declare: Pick a friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Summon Corpsemare Stampede
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Corpsemare Stampede on the battlefield, pick a friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Corpsemare Stampede wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

armies_of_renown.name: The Equinox Feast
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Flesh-eater Courts faction for your army, you can choose for it to be the Equinox Feast Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules in this section instead of the Flesh-eater Courts faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the EQUINOX FEAST keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
High Falconer Felgryn (must be included)
Any NON-UNIQUE NON-MONSTER HEROES
Any SERFS units
You cannot include Regiments of Renown

battle_traits.name: The Equinox Parade
battle_traits.effect:
In the first battle round:
• Add 1 to run rolls for friendly EQUINOX FEAST units for each other friendly EQUINOX FEAST unit that has used a RUN ability this phase.
• Add D6" to the distance friendly EQUINOX FEAST units can move when they use a RETREAT ability.

battle_traits.name: A Display of Falconry
battle_traits.declare: You can only use this ability in the second battle round. Pick each enemy unit that used a CHARGE ability this phase to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battle_traits.name: The Ritual Dance
battle_traits.effect: In the third battle round, while a friendly EQUINOX FEAST unit is in combat with an enemy unit that contains any champions, musicians or standard bearers, it can move 6" instead of 3" when it makes a pile-in move.

battle_traits.name: Eat Your Fill!
battle_traits.effect:
In the fourth battle round, each time a friendly EQUINOX FEAST unit uses a FIGHT ability, after that ability has been resolved:
• If that unit is damaged, Heal (D3) that unit.
• If that unit is not damaged, return up to 3 slain models to it.

battle_traits.name: Make Merry 'Til the Morn
battle_traits.effect: In the fifth battle round, friendly EQUINOX FEAST units have WARD (4+) while they are within 3" of 2 or more other visible friendly EQUINOX FEAST units.

entries.name: Lord of Revelries
entries.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

entries.name: Broken Sceptre of the Solstice
entries.declare: Pick a friendly EQUINOX FEAST unit that has been destroyed to be the target. This unit can use this ability if it has been destroyed, but if it does, this unit must be the target.
entries.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 6" of a friendly EQUINOX FEAST unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Solarite Flares
entries.declare: Pick a friendly EQUINOX FEAST WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a point on the battlefield that is visible to them, then pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point to be the targets. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: A Midsummer Mania
entries.declare: Pick a friendly EQUINOX FEAST PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this prayer this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Return D3 slain models to the target unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, return D3+3 slain models to the target unit instead.

entries.name: Summon Chalice of Ushoran
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Chalice of Ushoran on the battlefield, pick a friendly EQUINOX FEAST WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Chalice of Ushoran wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
